cases.name: detached
cases.meaning: Reproduces premature exit before marker script body.

conclusions: The exact Node25.2.1/libuv1.51.0 hosted comparison confirms the direct detached Windows PowerShell startup failure and supports the prior PC failure diagnosis.
A detached Node host spawning attached ordinary hidden PowerShell with three fresh pipes executes the script and forwards its actual exit status.

The original controller is forcibly terminated only after the marker acquires its real process handle and emits a complete READY line. PowerShell subsequently records parentLost and completed, and the host records actual child close0.

The marker source writes COMPLETE after parent loss and the host tolerates broken output. The result contains final-file and actual child-close evidence; it does not claim that the dead controller captured that final stdout.
All five recorded host/child/controller PIDs are absent; directly launched attached/detached children have observed close events. The complete probe lasts 2.554 seconds within all static bounds.
